description:
Show one sub-client by its customer_id: subscription status and expiry, and whether WhatsApp and Telegram are connected.

Requires a multi-customer account: a ChatPush client that may create sub-clients through the API.

customer_id.description: Internal ChatPush ID of the sub-customer.

include_tokens.description: Show the full sub-customer tokens. Default false: tokens are masked.

name: get_sub_customer
title: Get sub-customer
